objective: Compare supported MySQL clients against the Go and Rust TiProxy dataplanes without silent capability downgrade.

source_evidence: pkg/proxy/backend/cmd_processor_exec.go: query, multi-result, LOCAL INFILE, prepared statement, and cursor response state machines
pkg/proxy/net/compress_test.go: zlib, zstd, compressed sequence, and framing tests
pkg/proxy/net/packetio_test.go: long logical packet and sequence tests
known_contract_gaps: The Go handshake intersects optional client capabilities and logs unsupported bits; an exact-capability live case must fail if this produces a silent downgrade.

The current setCompress implementation prefers zlib when both CLIENT_COMPRESS and CLIENT_ZSTD_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM are present; exact zstd cases must record the negotiated algorithm and expose any fallback.
Some malformed-handshake paths are transport rejections rather than MySQL ERR packets; the runner must correlate the client error with the stable TiProxy log class.

execution_environment.network: One isolated bridge network; clients can reach only TiProxy SQL listeners, never TiDB directly.

adapter_options.tls_verification: mysql.RegisterTLSConfig with RootCAs and ServerName; DSN tls=tiproxy-verify
adapter_options.local_infile: mysql.RegisterLocalFile with the exact fixture path
infileStreamFactory returns a stream only for the exact fixture basename

adapter_options.tls_verification: SslOpts with root certificates; dangerous certificate/domain bypasses forbidden

adapter_options.connection_attributes: The client sends its built-in attributes; custom attributes are not configurable in mysql CLI 8.4.11.

adapter_options.purpose: Exercise exact capability combinations and malformed packets that supported application drivers cannot request safely.

records.note: Approved the frozen driver/capability compatibility matrix (7 drivers with pinned versions, 11 capabilities, 41 cases). The 3 non-blocking cases (DRV-GO-009, DRV-NODE-006, DRV-CLI-006) are client-driver limitations (go-sql-driver has no zstd, mysql2 has no COM_STMT_FETCH cursor API, mysql CLI SQL PREPARE is not COM_STMT_PREPARE), not proxy defects, so non-blocking is correct. No case reclassifications.
Approved the capability surface and the explicit-error-on-unsupported contract; unsupported behavior returns an explicit error rather than silently degrading.
